OpsBot: [ALERT] Node gpu-n12 has 3 container restarts in 5m. Cause hint: CUDA OOM during prefill (large-context). Severity: P1. Incident link: <https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-1792024607|INC-1792024607>

Eva (oncall): I'm taking this. Paging @Sasha and @Mike for infra/runtime. @Lina any customer reports yet?

Sasha (infra): saw the alert, pulling logs. dmesg / container log shows memory allocation failures during prefill. Snippet: ```[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (62): GPU memory allocation failed allocating 2048M
[ 12345.679002] oom-killer: task worker: Out of memory: Killed process 1234 (llm-worker)````

Mike (runtime): This looks like a long-context prefill spike. Traffic pattern: single chat requests with ~18k tokens, batch_size=6 -> alloc burst. We should throttle prefill tokens and enable kv-cache trimming ASAP.

Eva (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) apply KV trim + per-request token cap as an env canary on one replica 2) route long-context requests to fallback model 3) monitor restarts for 15m before larger actions.

Sasha (infra): Doing step 1 on the affected deployment now (canary). Command I'm running: `kubectl set env deploy/llm-worker adaptive_kv_trim=true KV_TRIM_THRESHOLD=0.7 MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS=12000 --record`

OpsBot: Deploy job started by Sasha on pool g-run-1 (canary). CI job id: 1792024610.

Lina (support): AcmeCorp reported intermittent timeouts at 02:11 UTC on their chat sessions. No evidence of data corruption. I've opened a customer case and added note: mitigation in progress.

Mike (runtime): While canary rolls, I'm pushing a temporary routing rule to divert very large contexts to quantized-model-q1: `route-rule add if request.max_tokens>14000 -> model:quant-q1 priority:high`. This reduces pressure on GPU memory.

Sasha (infra): Canary replica stable for 12m, memory usage peaked at ~82% and no restarts observed. Rolling to remaining replicas gradually.

Eva (oncall): Good signal. Keep canary running for 20m total. If stable, we keep this config and plan a scheduled patch to improve allocation/caching tomorrow.

Mike (runtime): FYI logs show prefill allocator spike: `alloc_peak: 31.2GB` before trim, and `alloc_peak: 18.6GB` after canary env. We'll capture heap profile and open an engineering ticket for a safer allocator fallback.

Lina (support): Notifying AcmeCorp status: "We've applied temporary throttles and routing; service degraded for very long chats. No data exposure. Engineering working on a permanent fix. ETA 4h."

Eva (oncall): Creating incident ticket with timeline and mitigations. Handing over to night rotation at 03:00 UTC. @Sasha please add node cordon/drain plan if restarts resume.

Sasha (infra): Will prepare cordon/drain doc: `kubectl cordon gpu-n12 && kubectl drain gpu-n12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` and warm up replacement node.

Mike (runtime): Also adding a temporary metric alert: if container restart_count > 2 within 10m -> auto-route long-context to quantized model and notify pager.

OpsBot: Incident status updated: mitigated (partial). Current severity: P2 (mitigation applied, monitoring). Link: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1792024607> :white_check_mark:

Eva (oncall): Hand-off note: main action items for next shift - complete heap profile analysis, schedule runtime patch for allocator, and coordinate customer updates. Good job team. :thumbsup:
